prompt:
Subject: draughts, English checkers board game. Direct overhead square wooden board, exactly EIGHT rows and EIGHT columns, 64 cells, alternating light cream and dark brown, top-left cell LIGHT. Two black circular counters on top row columns TWO and FOUR, both dark squares. Two red circular counters on bottom row columns ONE and THREE, both dark squares. ONLY FOUR COUNTERS TOTAL. The two red pieces and two black pieces MUST sit on DARK BROWN cells, never light cells. All other cells empty. No arrows. Exact 8 by 8 grid essential. No perspective.
Use only attached invidious.png as drawing-style reference. Thick rounded dark chocolate outlines, simple rounded 2D shapes, clean smooth solid color fills, few restrained flat shadow shapes. No watercolor, grain, mottling, speckles, paper texture, bleed, muddy patches or fuzzy edges. Every person has exactly two naturally attached arms and hands connected naturally to sleeves and shoulders. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows. All silhouettes clean smooth closed outlined shapes including water or grass. Avoid light beams, wind swirls and glows unless essential to word meaning. 512x512 PNG RGBA, no text.
en: Red and black counters sit on dark squares of a draughts board.
ja: 8×8のドラフツ盤の濃色のマスに、赤と黒の駒が二つずつ置かれている。
